_doc: Tier 3 version registry: the one place a version's status and purpose are written (t3_versions.py renders runs/VERSIONS.md from this plus each version's files). status: delivered (each delivery carries DELIVERY.md from gate/t3_delivery_report.py, t3_deliver.sh) | candidate | kept (read by name by rxzhou's tools: tier3_pack_remote.sh, t3_episode_remote.sh whitelist; never move or rename) | archived (runs/archive/, gate copies in gate/archive/, moves logged in archive/MOVED.tsv). A version that is superseded is archived at once. Names drop the tier3_cari4d_f830_ prefix where it applies.

tier3_cari4d.purpose: first batch; 20 pass the silhouette check, 9 in _suspect

sim.purpose: human scaled with the scene; superseded by f830_simreg

simreg.purpose: f830_sim + the 5 second-camera episodes registered to the main camera

tier3_cari4d_fp_pilot_f830.purpose: every-frame registration pilot, 15 episodes; its episodes enter best through convert_fp

tier3_cari4d_v2sel_f830.purpose: re-selection pilot (t3_reselect.sh); its episodes enter best through convert_v2

best.purpose: per-episode pick of the version with the least lost tracking (best.selection.json)

best_hchk.purpose: height post-process variant; what differs from best_h was not recorded

best_hm.purpose: height post-process + the human follows the object over held runs; delivered 10-13, rxzhou trains on it; delivery until 10-16, replaced by best_dr2s_dyn7; kept in place (rxzhou trains on it, whitelisted)

best_hm2.purpose: height post-process variant after best_hm; what differs was not recorded

best_d.from: best_hm (inferred: made after it, as replacement candidates)
best_d.purpose: depth post-process (t3_depth_post.py), first run; variants d/dw/dc/dr/dr2 differ in settings that were not recorded

best_dw.from: best_hm (inferred: made after it, as replacement candidates)

best_dc.from: best_hm (inferred: made after it, as replacement candidates)

best_dr.from: best_hm (inferred: made after it, as replacement candidates)

best_dr2.from: best_hm (inferred: made after it, as replacement candidates)

best_dr3.purpose: unattended depth candidate; failed the replacement criteria (~/v2d/tier3/auto/decision_report.txt), user stopped replacing best_hm

best_dr2s.from: best (confirmed 10-16: its recorded moves equal dr2s minus best)
best_dr2s.purpose: depth correction along the viewing ray, capped +-5%, rest vertical; support rule v2 (10-13). Failed the 10-13 criteria on pose jumps (73 vs 70) and the gate (29/30) while keeping IoU 0.807 (hm 0.737); restored from the archive 10-16 for re-evaluation

best_dyn1.purpose: dynamics post-process v1, 4 pilot episodes; superseded by dyn4 (handoff-tier3-dynamics-2026-10-14.md)

best_dyn2.purpose: held state from the robot layer; discarded

best_dyn3.purpose: held runs trimmed by the robot layer; discarded

best_dyn.purpose: dyn1 rules on all 30; exposed three wrong rules; discarded

best_dynr.purpose: intermediate run after fixing those rules; unrecorded differences from dyn4; discarded

best_dyn4.purpose: dynamics post-process (7a4bf37); its symmetry rule was wrong (turned objects into wrong poses); rxzhou evaluated it on ep12

best_dyn5.purpose: locks from the check's own contact states; ep29 locked whole; do not use

best_dyn6.purpose: dyn4 rules + new symmetry rule (uncommitted code); step 3 still turned objects; do not use

best_dyn7.purpose: new symmetry rule + robust step 3 + tapered offsets (037ae97); 2162 violation frames

best_kf2.purpose: contact-switched Kalman/RTS (t3_kalman_post.py, 52542c8); 2080 violation frames; rests creep (rot_drift 1122)

best_kf3.purpose: kf2 + rests locked as dyn7, rests <= 5 frames apart merged, bridged by the filter (9c3bfb2); 1675 violation frames, gate 25/30, ours 30/30

best_dr2s_dyn7.purpose: dyn7's dynamics post-process (ebad90b) on the ray-corrected best_dr2s; IoU 0.810 (best 0.810, hm 0.738), 2189 violation frames, 7 clean, airborne 274; gate 30/30 with supports runs/support/tier3_cari4d_f830_best_v3 (centre-of-mass sweep, 1723b15), 29/30 with v2 (ep07). Orientation flips untouched; ep07 iron sinks ~1 cm at the table edge (dr2s made with v2 supports); DELIVERED 10-16 13:48 (report runs/<version>/DELIVERY.md, agent-doc/delivery-tier3-best_dr2s_dyn7-2026-10-16.md); delivery until 10-17, replaced by tier3_cari4d_gb_best_dr2s_dyn7; kept in place (rxzhou may train on it or have whitelisted it)

best_dr2srepro.purpose: best_dr2s regenerated with the current code (14e2e3b) and the v2 supports, to prove the code reproduces it; moved to the archive after the comparison

best_dr2s3.purpose: best_dr2s's along-ray depth correction (--move-human=3d) with the v3 supports (centre-of-mass sweep), with provenance

best_dr2s3_dyn7.purpose: dyn7's dynamics post-process on best_dr2s3; replaces best_dr2s_dyn7 only if the self-check shows nothing worse

tier3_cari4d_gb_best.purpose: per-episode pick as best (same selection), every convert dir re-expressed under the calibrated intrinsics GB (f 866.3, cx 701.8, cy 531.1, rxzhou ceiling grid) on all three cameras, floor_fit_gb3 (main 1.222 deg / 0.984; second camera scale 0.949 from t3_register_check.py), camera_register_gb3 (second 181.38 deg; ep21 its 10-12 tripod pair, GB on evidence insufficient but tested); made by t3_gb_chain.sh Superseded 10-18 by the gb4 regeneration; left in place under its name (user 10-18: rxzhou already copied the gb3 delivery, so the fix took a new name instead of replacing it).

tier3_cari4d_gb_best_dr2s.purpose: depth correction along the viewing ray as best_dr2s (--move-human=3d), on gb_best with supports runs/support/tier3_cari4d_gb_best Superseded 10-18 by the gb4 regeneration; left in place under its name (user 10-18: rxzhou already copied the gb3 delivery, so the fix took a new name instead of replacing it).

tier3_cari4d_gb_best_dr2s_dyn7.purpose: dyn7 dynamics post-process as best_dr2s_dyn7, on gb_best_dr2s; checked by gate/chain_check.sh set gbdyn7; self-check 5 of 6 (ep16 image review failed); DELIVERED 10-17 by user decision with known issues: the focal step moves the body rigidly with the pelvis while the object follows the point map, so hands drift 1-6.5 cm from held objects (ep01, ep16 worst), fixed in the gb4 regeneration (report runs/<version>/DELIVERY.md, agent-doc/delivery-tier3-gb_best_dr2s_dyn7-2026-10-17.md) Superseded as the delivery by tier3_cari4d_gb4_best_dr2s_dyn7 (10-18); kept in place, rxzhou has a copy.

tier3_cari4d_gb4_best.purpose: as gb_best (same selection, same GB intrinsics), with the focal step refitting instead of moving rigidly: the object Kabsch-fitted to its point-mapped surface, the body by SOMA PoseInversion (analytic + 20 autograd steps, hands and feet weight 5) to the point-mapped mesh (t3_convert_ep.py focal, e5ab7e5; body vertex p90 12.5 mm median, 23.0 max over 54 convert dirs); regenerated in an isolated root (dev/gbfix) and moved in as convert_*_gb4; floor_fit_gb4 (main 0.964 deg / 0.982, second camera 2.173 deg, scale 0.949), camera_register_gb4 (second 181.53 deg, ep21 84.94 deg); made by t3_gb_chain.sh gb4 Superseded 10-21 by tier3_cari4d_gb5_best (same chain, 13 FP episodes re-selected); archived.

tier3_cari4d_gb4_best_dr2s.purpose: depth correction along the viewing ray as best_dr2s (--move-human=3d), on gb4_best with supports runs/support/tier3_cari4d_gb4_best Superseded 10-21 by tier3_cari4d_gb5_best_dr2s; archived.

tier3_cari4d_gb4_best_dr2s_dyn7.purpose: dyn7 dynamics post-process as best_dr2s_dyn7, on gb4_best_dr2s; checked by gate/chain_check.sh set gb4dyn7; self-check 6 of 6 (ep16 frame 130 fixed); labelled contact frames back to the f830 level (18133 vs gb3 16496, f830 18263); DELIVERED 10-18 by user decision, known issue ep11: the human hand is on the book but our copy of the retarget leaves the robot right hand 3-5 cm off in 41 frames (report runs/<version>/DELIVERY.md, agent-doc/delivery-tier3-gb4_best_dr2s_dyn7-2026-10-18.md) Superseded as the delivery by tier3_cari4d_gb5_best_dr2s_dyn7 (10-21); kept in place: rxzhou's packing whitelist reads it by name and he trains on it.

tier3_cari4d_gb5_best.purpose: gb4_best with the 13 episodes whose pick is FoundationPose's (convert_fp) re-initialized by the timeline selector (t3_fp_select.py, BETA 0.5, A/B winner 10-20) on the dumped candidates and CoCoNet 06-08 re-run (runs/work_b050), converted into convert_fp_gb5; the other 17 episodes' convert dirs hard-linked from gb4; gb4's floor fit and camera registration (same world frame); made by t3_sel_full.sh gb5 (ep19 not included)

tier3_cari4d_gb5_best_dr2s.purpose: depth correction along the viewing ray as best_dr2s (--move-human=3d), on gb5_best with supports runs/support/tier3_cari4d_gb5_best

tier3_cari4d_gb5_best_dr2s_dyn7.purpose: dyn7 dynamics post-process on gb5_best_dr2s; checked by gate/chain_check.sh set gb5dyn7 and the registered gb5 machine gate (ATTRIBUTE M5 M6 against gb4, attributed in agent-doc/handoff-tier3-rotation-2026-10-21-attr.md: the changes follow the selector's orientation changes; gb5 is right on some segments and wrong on others); user whole-batch review against gb4: old right, new wrong 3/75 frames (7/75 counting gb4 a little better), within the 10% line; DELIVERED 10-21 by user decision (report runs/<version>/DELIVERY.md, agent-doc/delivery-tier3-gb5_best_dr2s_dyn7-2026-10-21.md); support_surface updated in place 10-21 (user decision): ep01 gains two lean boxes from gate/t3_lean_support.py (bc1d566), parquet and the other 29 usda unchanged, our-support gate 30/30 identical line by line; the previous usda dir is $G/archive/support_usda_gb5dyn7_before_lean_1021

tier3_cari4d_gb6_best.purpose: gb5_best with ROT_DEG 5 (instead of 10) in the timeline selector on the episodes t3_rot_rule.py picks (changed-frame silhouette IoU gain > 0.02 at FP stage 05, Tier 3 inputs only; picked ep11, ep17), CARI4D 06-08 re-run for those two in runs/work_rot_gb6 and converted into convert_fp_gb6; the other episodes' convert dirs copied from gb5; gb4's floor fit and camera registration; made by t3_rot_full.sh gb6 gb5 (11-04; its chain check stopped on the alignment KeyError fixed in e6e2f19e and was resumed by dev/gb6_resume.sh)

tier3_cari4d_gb6_best_dr2s.purpose: depth correction along the viewing ray as best_dr2s (--move-human=3d), on gb6_best with supports runs/support/tier3_cari4d_gb6_best

tier3_cari4d_gb6_best_dr2s_dyn7.purpose: dyn7 dynamics post-process on gb6_best_dr2s; the second Tier 3 final (user 11-04), gb5_best_dr2s_dyn7 stays delivered as the first; checked by gate/chain_check.sh set gb6dyn7 and gate/dyn/gb6_selfcheck_now.sh against gb5_best_dr2s_dyn7: dynamics, hand-object and the pose audit differ from gb5 only on ep11 and ep17; the other 28 episodes' tables equal gb5's (metadata differs only by the version name), their support usda byte-identical except ep01, whose two lean boxes moved about 1.4 mm (inferred: t3_lean_support.py samples the mesh unseeded under trimesh 4.5.1); ep17 delivered-layer dynamics violations 26 -> 46, not attributed; the chain was not run end to end (resumed after the alignment KeyError, step 4 run separately, no ROT_FULL_DONE); delivery-layer texture sheets not seen by the user; DELIVERED 11-04 by user decision (report runs/<version>/DELIVERY.md)

work.work_fp: FoundationPose register-every-frame runs (input to convert_fp; base of the stage pilots)
work.work_init: pending: initialization pilot (t3_init_pilot.sh, 10-16); created when the pilot starts
work.work_b050: timeline-selection runs (t3_fp_select.py BETA 0.5) of the 13 FP episodes, CARI4D 05-08 (08 render skipped); input to convert_fp_gb5 (gb5)
work.work_dump: FoundationPose candidate dumps (t3_fp_dump.sh) of 14 episodes, input to t3_fp_select.py
work.work_b000: archived 10-21 (runs/archive/work_b000): BETA 0 run of the 10-20 A/B (ep03/04/13); superseded by work_b050
work.work_b010: archived 10-21 (runs/archive/work_b010): BETA 0.1 run of the 10-20 A/B; superseded by work_b050
work.work_b020: archived 10-21 (runs/archive/work_b020): BETA 0.2 run of the 10-20 A/B; superseded by work_b050
work.work_b030: archived 10-21 (runs/archive/work_b030): BETA 0.3 run of the 10-20 A/B; superseded by work_b050
work.work_sel: archived 10-21 (runs/archive/work_sel): 10-19 timeline-selection pilot (BETA 0, ep03/04); superseded by work_b050
work.work_anchor: archived 10-21 (runs/archive/work_anchor): 10-20 anchored-selection re-run with BETA 0.316 from the answer frames, stopped before 06 (stage 05 only; no evidence); superseded by work_b050
work.work_rot_gb6: ROT_DEG 5 selection runs of ep11 and ep17 (copies of work_fp with stages 06-08 cleared and re-run, 08 render skipped); input to convert_fp_gb6 (gb6). rule records in runs/rot_rule_gb6 (t3_rot_full.sh)
